svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Monitoring and alerting in Project Aether. Prometheus, Loki, Alertmanager and Grafana run on the cloud host, off the cluster. Prometheus scrapes node exporters on the cluster nodes, the hypervisor (with ZFS metrics) and the edge VM, plus kube-state-metrics, ArgoCD and the PostgreSQL and Redis exporters, all over the private mesh. Grafana Alloy on every cluster node ships logs to Loki. Alertmanager sends alerts to Telegram. A Watchdog alert that always fires goes to Uptime Kuma on the edge VM, which also receives backup heartbeats and checks the apps over HTTPS from outside; if a heartbeat stops, Uptime Kuma alerts Telegram.
svg.text: Monitoring runs on the cloud host, off the cluster, so it still works when the home lab doesn't.
